title: The Pillars of the Earth
author: Ken Follett
summary: In twelfth-century England, a master builder dreams of constructing a great cathedral at Kingsbridge, while civil war, scheming churchmen and local lords threaten his plans and the people around him.
readIf: you like long, absorbing historical sagas with clear heroes and villains.
skipIf: you want subtle moral shading, or want to avoid scenes of sexual violence.

pairings.reason: Medieval-style power struggles with a cast of schemers, but in a fantasy world.
A more literary look at political power in an earlier English era.
Another medieval story built around a monastery and the secrets of the Church.
